correctness.rationale: The exact finite covariance follows from simplex translation volume, which gives marginal and off-diagonal joint exceedance probabilities. A positive factorization yields a strictly decreasing threshold function with exactly the three claimed regimes and a root inside (a,1-a); critical zero cases have an explicit dependence witness. Fixed-scale asymptotics are obtained from Taylor expansions. The final package verifier passes 7763 corroborating assertions; no finite calculation is used to claim a proof for all n.

value.rationale: Two nested uncovered-component counts encode circle coverage at two physically meaningful arc lengths. The theorem classifies every admissible finite parameter pair, including surprising negative covariance despite pointwise ordering and a full nonindependent zero-covariance band at the unique mean-one cutoff. This is a motivated structural dependence boundary, not a one-off numerical moment, and supplies exact finite calibration useful for multiscale coverage statistics.
